title: 校园可重复使用杯的流转
prompt:
The diagram follows a reusable cup through a deposit scheme at a university. Describe the main stages and explain how the route changes after inspection.

Write at least 150 words.
chart_data: A campus cup-deposit system. A café lends a washed cup on payment of a deposit. The customer returns the used cup to a collection point and receives the deposit back. Staff take returned cups to an inspection station. Damaged cups are sent for recycling. Undamaged cups are washed, dried, and delivered back to cafés for their next loan.

title: 广场改造前后的布局
prompt:
The plans show the layout of Westfield Square in 2010 and after changes completed in 2025. Describe the main changes and identify any features that remained.

Write at least 150 words.
chart_data: Westfield Square, north at the top. A shared street (Oak Road) runs across the south in both 2010 and 2025. In 2010 a car park occupied the north-west, with a lawn to the north-east; a market hall stood in the south-west, with a pond to its east. In 2025 the car park was replaced by a community garden and the lawn by a play area. A café replaced the market hall, while the pond stayed in place. A new east–west footpath separates the northern and southern halves of the square; it did not exist in 2010.
